extraction.notes: Three-month (Sept 30, 2024) column only. Share count 119,954 (thousands) from the FFO Shares and Units section on page 9 (also repeated on page 11); it reproduces reported per-share figures: 251,688/119,954 = 2.10, 264,764/119,954 = 2.21, 231,229/119,954 = 1.93. Zero-value lines (loss on sale of depreciable real estate, gain on sale of non-depreciable real estate, gain on debt extinguishment, legal costs, mark-to-market debt adjustment) shown as dashes/zero in the quarter. The gain on consolidation of third-party development is printed as a parenthetical (11,033) and signed negative; it is categorized as nareit_other. Other capital expenditure lines (redevelopment, revenue enhancing, commercial, other) appear below Core AFFO in the FAD section and were not included in AFFO.
